summary: Merge (voice agent + satellite parking) tested end-to-end. Backend: 51/51 pytest pass (new test_merge_parking_voice.py + updated test_options_google.py + previous suites). /api/voice with /tmp/q.mp3 -> route_set with place, route, parking (verdict/label/tips/spots), options (3 others), audio_url GET audio/mpeg. /api/agent hotel/vague -> route_set, 'how far is it?' w/ active_place -> chat, gibberish -> not_understood, lat=999 -> 422. /api/parking 38.5935,-121.43 -> likely + entry/park tips + spots. Listed-in-data place with disagreeing imagery (Manhattan) -> unclear 'Truck parking listed, not visible on satellite'. /api/satellite returns image/jpeg (422 on bad lat). Frontend (375x667, fake mic streaming q.mp3): no category chips; stages Searching -> Checking satellite -> Setting route; Navigating card ~10s with parking label/reason, satellite thumb -> modal (opens/closes), 'You said: ...' caption; 'See 3 other options' -> options list; See parking shows Checking… then likely + E/P tips + thumb with E/P markers; Close returns to route card; Route on another option reroutes (previous destination re-added to options); End route resets to 'Where to next?'. Mic denied: ask card -> Allow -> blocked card with Open Settings; tapping it on web doesn't crash; Not now dismisses. No page errors. No deprecated packages (expo-av etc.) found.

minor.issue: Best place is chosen by the LLM before the satellite check and never re-evaluated: for 'I need fuel' it routes to Capitol Truck Plaza (satellite: residential, verdict unclear/'unlikely' in reply) while option Sierra Fuel & Truck Stop is 'Likely fits a truck'. Driver gets routed to a spot the agent itself says probably won't fit.

Listed place + vision 'unclear' (e.g. 'Image too dark to judge' over water, Lake Tahoe test) returns verdict 'listed' (green check) with reason 'Image too dark to judge' — contradictory label/reason. Only 'unlikely' demotes listed.
Cache keyed only by rounded coords, ignores whether the place is listed (tags); same coords with different tags returns the stale verdict/label.

integration_issues.issue: Picking another option via 'Route' doesn't clear/update the caption bubble or speak anything; the old voice reply ('Found Capitol Truck Plaza...') can still be shown for up to 8s while the card now shows Northgate Travel Center.

issues: CaptionBubble is anchored at bottom=sheetH+16 with no top limit; with the taller navigating card (parking row) the 4-line reply grows up over the TopBar, covering the menu button and truck profile chip at 375x667 (src/components/Toast.tsx:40). Clamp with maxHeight/top>=topH or numberOfLines.

ScrollView maxHeight = 30% of window (~200px at 667h). After 'See parking' expands a card (label + 2 tips + thumb), the card's Route/See parking buttons are pushed below the fold and need inner scrolling (src/components/OptionsList.tsx:111).
Satellite thumbnail showed as an empty grey box ~1.5s after the route card appeared (image still loading, no placeholder/spinner).
'P' marker uses colors.onInfo text on success background; use onSuccess token (ParkingStatus.tsx:46).

action_items: Agent: after search, consider running check_parking for the top 2-3 candidates in parallel (cached) and route to the best verdict (listed/likely) instead of a place the satellite says won't fit; or fall back to next candidate when verdict is unlikely/unclear.
parking.py: when listed and vision is 'unclear', don't surface the vision reason ('Image too dark…') under a 'listed' label — use LISTED reason; include listed flag in the verdict cache key.
Clamp CaptionBubble so it never overlaps the TopBar (top >= topH + 8 or numberOfLines on reply).
OptionsList: increase maxHeight (e.g. 45%) or keep buttons visible when parking result expands a card.
On option 'Route', clear/replace the caption (e.g. 'Route set to X') and optionally speak it.
Add a placeholder/spinner for the satellite thumbnail while loading.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx backToIdle reads `options` from the render closure inside async submitTurn/onPlacePress — may use stale value; use a ref like activeRef.
LLM decides the best place before parking data exists, so 'best' ignores the satellite verdict (see backend minor #1).
No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch absent).

Mic blocked state: testID mic-permission-settings-button. Parking results are cached in memory by coords; restart backend to force fresh vision calls.
